# The six verbs

Six words do most of the work. You can keep rows, choose columns, add a column,
summarize by group, sort, and take the first few. Almost everything people
actually do to a table is some arrangement of those six.

This part introduces them one at a time, and every chapter is short on purpose.
By the end of it you can answer real questions, and the rest of the book is the
same six verbs with more to say inside them. Two short chapters close the part:
renaming and dropping repeats, and the small words that travel with every verb.

If you have used dplyr, you already know five of these under other names. If you
have used pandas or SQL, you know all six as several different spellings each,
and the point of this part is that here there is one spelling.
